name: Election
description: Voted by the public through universal suffrage. See Article 137 (President) and Article 180 (Governor) at www.klrc.go.ke

name: Nomination
description: Appointed by political parties to represent special interests (gender youth PWDs) as per Article 97 and Article 98 at www.klrc.go.ke

name: Appointment
description: Direct selection by a high-ranking state officer or commission (Cabinet Secretaries Judges) as per Article 152 and Article 166 at www.klrc.go.ke

name: Ex-Officio
description: Holding office by virtue of holding another office (Speakers Attorney General in Cabinet) as per Article 152 at www.klrc.go.ke

name: Competitive Recruitment
description: Selected through a formal interview process by a commission (Principal Secretaries Commissioners) as per Article 155 and Article 250 at www.klrc.go.ke
